handoffPurpose: Record the Goth Girl Baddie class asset cleanup and gameplay wiring performed on the Windows desktop clone.
currentUserGoal: Add Goth Girl Baddie as a selectable character class using the new transparent pixel-art portrait, with class skills and quest support.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Created and saved the Goth Girl Baddie class portrait asset.
details: Generated a pixel-art Goth Girl Baddie portrait from the user-provided source.
Reworked the asset with a chroma-key background and local alpha removal so it matches the transparent class portrait style.
Saved the final 128x128 transparent PNG at public/assets/ui/classes/goth-girl-baddie.png.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Wired Goth Girl Baddie into the class and progression systems.
details: Added the goth_girl_baddie CharacterClassId and save validation support.
Added the Goth Girl Baddie class definition with the class-goth-girl-baddie icon key and portrait path.
Added the Moonlit Main Character passive: crit chance, gold drop chance, and rare grass odds.

Added class quest entries for buying Black Nail Polish and maxing Graveyard Shift.
Updated class quest coloring and skill branch categorization for the new skills.
Adjusted the class selection panel to lay out exactly four classes as a 2x2 grid on non-narrow screens.
